title: Salary.
bodyText: The salary of the administrator shall be set by the director of commerce and consumer affairs, but shall not be more than ninety-five per cent of the maximum salary of the commissioner.
bodyHtml: [§431:19-101.6]  Salary.  The salary of the administrator shall be set by the director of commerce and consumer affairs, but shall not be more than ninety-five per cent of the maximum salary of the commissioner. [L 1997, c 261, pt of §2]
